answer: Agents submit a one‑time‑use “inlet” token, a cryptographic nonce signed by a trusted crystal authority, then later reveal a pre‑committed answer containing a relic‑derived seed word; the network verifies the nonce matches the reveal and that the seed hashes to the authority’s current crystal key. Any Sybil must obtain a fresh inlet token and a matching crystal signature for each identity, forcing the attacker to lock up a stake of 10 % of the network’s token per fake node and wait the mandatory 24‑hour reveal period, after which the stake is forfeited if the reveal fails.
